description:
Here are the descriptions of the provided plots, following your guidelines:

The plot illustrates the relationship between temperature and accuracy for different on-policy reinforcement learning methods. The x-axis is labeled “Temperature” with a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy (Pass@k)” with a linear scale ranging from 62.5 to 82.5, with tick labels at intervals of 2.5. A red line with triangle markers represents “LUFFY”, starting at approximately 79.5 at a temperature of 0.0 and decreasing to approximately 76.0 at a temperature of 1.0. A maroon line with star markers represents “SFT”, beginning at approximately 77.0 at a temperature of 0.0 and decreasing to approximately 72.0 at a temperature of 1.0. A teal line with downward-pointing triangle markers represents “On-policy RL”, starting at approximately 76.0 at a temperature of 0.0 and decreasing to approximately 73.0 at a temperature of 1.0. An orange line with square markers represents a method not labeled in the plot, starting at approximately 78.0 at a temperature of 0.0 and decreasing to approximately 75.0 at a temperature of 1.0.
